searchText: Hi <@159152274659082240> and <@898563924440543283> , any idea if `blobs-util` is updated? I'm getting the following error sending gms... ``` 2023/03/21 08:50:11 App failed: offset 0 is incorrect, expected 16, got 60: unable to send transaction ``` Geth: ``` > WARN [03-21|08:46:49.730] Served eth_sendRawTransaction conn=127.0.0.1:55884 reqid=2 duration=8.477791ms err="offset 0 is incorrect, expected 16, got 60" ``` it hasn't been updated. Fixing. I've updated blob-utils. Lemme know if it doesn't work for you. Should we move blob-utils into eip8844-interop rather than have it separate <@159152274659082240> ? We could put something in the CI to make sure it doesn't get out of sync New error now 🙂 ``` ./blob-utils tx --blob-file <(echo hello) --private-key 2e0834786285daccd064ca17f1654f67b4aef298acbb82cef9ec422fb4975622 --to 0x0 --gas-price 100000000000 --gas-limit 1000000 --chain-id 32382 --rpc-url http://localhost:8545 2023/03/21 15:56:54 App failed: error during proof verification: can't verify opening proof: unable to send transaction ```
